payout_quote: Get $50 CASH for every friend or family member who joins & sets up direct deposit. ... No limits on referrals. The referral incentive will be deposited to the existing member's account within 90 days of the referred member's account opening and will be reported to the IRS.
steps: Be a Florida West Coast Credit Union member; fill out the referral card with your name and give it to a friend or family member.
The new member opens a new checking account (minimum $20 to open Free Checking) with a NEW direct deposit of at least $1,500 per month.
The new member's direct deposit must post within 60 days of account opening; current checking accounts do not qualify.
You receive $50 cash deposited to your account within 90 days of the referred member's account opening; no limits on referrals.
catches: The friend needs a genuine new direct deposit of at least $1,500 per month posting within 60 days - a high bar that casual signups won't clear.
Current checking accounts do not qualify - the referred person must be opening a new checking account.
The incentive takes up to 90 days to arrive and is reported to the IRS.
Minimum $20 to open the friend's Free Checking account.
biggest_catch: Your friend needs a real $1,500/month direct deposit hitting within 60 days - without that, nobody gets the $50.
eligibility: FWCCU members (new member must be eligible for credit union membership); referred person must open a new checking account.
timing: Referral incentive deposited to the existing member's account within 90 days of the referred member's account opening.
